text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find meaning in what people write. NLP is used in translation apps that change text from one language to another. It also powers sentiment analysis, which shows whether a review is positive or negative. Another common example is chatbots, which answer questions and talk with users online. Thanks to NLP, computers can work with language in ways that feel more natural and useful every day.
